sloka: स त्वमिक्ष्वाकुनाथं वै क्षिपन्निह न लज्जसे ।चक्षुषो विषयं तस्य न तावदुपगच्छसि ।। ५.२०.१७।।।।
transliteration: sa tvamikṣvākunāthaṁ vai kṣipanniha na lajjase ।cakṣuṣo viṣayaṁ tasya na tāvadupagacchasi ।। 5.20.17।।।।

translations.english: "O timid lady, gems brought forcibly from all the worlds, this kingdom as well as myself are yours.
